data: real Huesken features + ViennaRNA seed dG (standardized); knockdown fraction
forward_map: ridge f(x) = x w + c (lambda=1) predicting knockdown fraction

polytope.equality: Z^+ y = (a, b), Z = [1, dG]; (a,b) = OLS(knockdown on [1,dG])
polytope.solver: Pinet Douglas-Rachford / ADMM (eq + box), sigma=0.1 omega=1.7 n_iter=2000

composed_bound.x_star: the real Huesken feature matrix X (perturbations are seeded probes)

admm_active_set.note: Real Huesken knockdowns are moderate (~0.27-0.69), so the occupancy box 0<=theta<=1 is naturally SLACK (f(X)'s projection has 0 active box coords). The active-set and gradient tests below use a box-activating 4x affine spread of the real forward output (10 of 64 coordinates fall outside [0,1] before projection) so the eq+box ADMM active set and the IFT stop condition are genuinely exercised.

stop_condition.criterion: IFT gradient through (equality + box) projection vs central FD < 1e-6; else fall back to the unrolled augmented-Lagrangian (ADMM) differentiable layer.
